requirement.description: The _runner function is failing to properly handle artifact loading and dumping for Pydantic models, particularly with non-base models and custom loaders. Multiple test failures indicate that the artifact serialization/deserialization logic doesn't properly handle various Pydantic modes (v1 vs v2) and loader configurations.
requirement.contract: Fix the artifact loading and dumping functionality in the _runner module to correctly process Pydantic models with custom loaders and serializers, supporting both Pydantic v1 and v2 modes. The implementation should handle non-base model classes properly and ensure correct file path resolution for artifact operations.

requirement.description: The _runner function fails with IsADirectoryError when attempting to write outputs to directories that haven't been properly created, particularly in pydantic output scenarios. This indicates issues with directory creation and path handling in the output management logic.
requirement.contract: Improve the output directory creation logic in the _runner function to ensure all necessary directories are created before attempting to write artifact/output files. The function should handle path resolution and directory creation robustly for both parameter and artifact outputs.

requirement.description: The _runner function encounters KeyError issues when processing function parameters with kebab-case naming conventions. This suggests that parameter mapping logic doesn't properly handle parameter names with hyphens, which are common in Argo workflows.
requirement.contract: Enhance the parameter parsing and mapping logic in the _runner function to correctly handle parameter names with special characters like hyphens (kebab-case), ensuring proper mapping between workflow parameters and function arguments.

requirement.description: The _runner function fails with AttributeError when trying to access attributes in example workflows. This points to issues with how imported modules are handled during the runner execution, particularly with example workflow modules.
requirement.contract: Fix the module importing and attribute access logic in the _runner function to properly resolve and access functions from example workflows and other modules. The implementation should handle dynamic imports and attribute resolution correctly.

requirement.description: The _runner function fails with FileNotFoundError when dealing with artifact inputs that have missing or incorrect paths. This indicates that artifact input handling doesn't properly validate or handle missing artifact files.
requirement.contract: Improve artifact input validation and error handling in the _runner function to properly manage cases where artifact files are missing or have incorrect paths, ensuring graceful error handling instead of crashing.
